# Signhify

> AI engineering studio. Describe your idea — we design, engineer, automate and launch it end-to-end.

Signhify is an AI-first product studio founded by Piyush Raj Singh. Registered MSME (Govt. of India). We ship SaaS, AI agents, CRMs, landing pages and growth systems for ambitious founders, and are building a broader AI product ecosystem (Studio → AI → Deploy → Marketplace → Cloud → OS) by 2030.
